shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index dropped 418 points or 0.79 percent on Tuesday to close at 52768 points.Losses were led by Sherwin-Williams (-2.63%), Goldman Sachs (-2.52%) and Nike (-2.46%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Apple (2.58%), Chevron (2.33%) and J&J (2.14%).

children: The Dow Jones Index dropped 418 points or 0.79 percent on Tuesday to close at 52768 points.
Losses were led by Sherwin-Williams (-2.63%), Goldman Sachs (-2.52%) and Nike (-2.46%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Apple (2.58%), Chevron (2.33%) and J&J (2.14%).

title: The Dow Jones Index Closes 0.79% Lower
